title: elaeagnus conferta var. balansae
intro: Elaeagnus conferta var. balansae, commonly known as Silverбуш, is a type of flowering shrub native to the mountainous regions of China and the Himalayas. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and prevent the growth of certain bacteria. The therapeutic actions of Elaeagnus conferta var. balansae include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
